svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: The width of each bar shows countries scaled by population size. The height of each bar measures tonnes of per
capita carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions from fossil fuels and industry.

tspan.tspan: Global Carbon Budget (2025); Population based on various sources (2024)
Where data for 1800 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 1801 and 1803 is shown instead.
